meta.description: Use this skill for OpenFold2, NVIDIA's BioNeMo NIM microservice for monomer protein structure prediction. Invoke whenever the user mentions OpenFold2, AlphaFold2-like monomer folding, protein sequence-to-structure prediction, A3M MSAs, mmCIF templates, hosted NVIDIA API calls, or local Docker deployment.

recommendations.title: Add timeout guidance for long sequences
recommendations.problem: No guidance on handling timeout for sequences approaching limits (2048 residues local, 1000 hosted)
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes default 300s timeout sufficient; long sequences may exceed this
recommendations.fix: Add to Troubleshooting: 'Timeout on long sequences (>500 residues) → increase requests timeout parameter to 600-900s. With 5 models + relax, sequences near 1000 residues may take 10-15 minutes. For very long sequences (1500-2048 on local), consider reducing to 1-2 models or disabling relaxation.'

recommendations.title: Add inline example for explicit_templates
recommendations.problem: explicit_templates with mmCIF content mentioned as 2.0.0+ feature but format not shown inline
recommendations.root_cause: Delegates to references without minimal inline example
recommendations.fix: Add after explicit_templates mention in gotchas: 'Example: "explicit_templates": [{"id": "1abc", "mmcif_string": "data_1abc\n_entry.id 1abc\n..."}] — see references/examples.md for full template structure.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for predictions
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running prediction with same sequence and MSA produces identical structures
recommendations.fix: Add to Save And Interpret Output: 'Determinism: OpenFold2 predictions are deterministic — same sequence, MSA, templates, and selected_models produce identical structures across runs. For stochastic diversity, vary MSA depth or template selection rather than running multiple times with identical inputs.'
